description: Attorney Pete Pearson introduces his new website, www.petepearsonlaw.com, with more about him, his legal services, and his attorney fee contract.
shortAnswer: It is with great expectations that I introduce my new website, www.petepearsonlaw.com. Aside from the fresh look, the site offers you, as a prospective client, more information about me, my legal services, and even has a link to the attorney fee contract you would sign if you retain me.
